claims.value: BaF3-<G>_G-CSF-<t>min_rep<n> (heavy) / BaF3-<G>_unstimulated_<t>min-mix-rep<n> (light), G in WT,T618I,Q741x; t in 12.5,90; n in 1,2
claims.evidence: One source per SILAC-labelled culture: each of the 12 mixtures = one G-CSF-stimulated heavy culture + one unstimulated light culture (Suppl. Methods: "Cells grown in heavy SILAC medium were stimulated with G-CSF (40 ng/mL) for 12.5 mins and 90 mins ... cells grown in light medium were left unstimulated"; paper: "two independent biological replicates"). Genotype from the RAW zip (WTRAWDATA/T618IRAWDATA/Q741XRAWDATA) and the .group names; time and replicate from each .wiff embedded Sample Name (e.g. "Pankaj_SILAC T618I pY 90 min Rep 1", "Pankaj_SILAC 12.5 min pY eluete replicate 2"). The naming scheme matches the companion annotation of PXD009311 (same lysate mixtures per Sci Data: pS/pT = pY1000 flow-through); the replicate-number correspondence across the two deposits is by label, not otherwise verified.

Each RAW zip holds 4 .wiff + 4 .wiff.scan. Embedded Sample Names: Data111015_02 "SILAC 12.5 min pY eluete replicate 1", _04 "12.5 min ... replicate 2", _06 "90 min ... replicate 1", _08 "90 min ... replicate 2"; Data080216_02 "T618I pY 12.5 min Rep 1", _03 "12.5 min Rep 2", _05 "90 min Rep 1", _06 "90 min Rep 2"; Data021716_01 "Q741x_12.5 min pY Rep 1", _02 "12.5 min Rep 2", _04 "90 min Rep 1", _05 "90 min Rep 2". Each .group file searched exactly that one .wiff (input path in the group header) and its file name repeats the same genotype/time/replicate. comment[data file] names the .wiff member inside its zip; its .wiff.scan companion is in the same zip.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + characteristics[sampling time] + factor values rows 1-24
claims.value: SILAC light = unstimulated (untreated, sampling time not applicable); SILAC heavy = G-CSF 12.5 or 90 minute
claims.evidence: Explicit: Suppl. Methods "Cells grown in heavy SILAC medium were stimulated with G-CSF (40 ng/mL) for 12.5 mins and 90 mins at 37 C and cells grown in light medium were left unstimulated"; paper Results "cells grown in light SILAC medium for the non-G-CSF induced control and the heavy SILAC medium as the GCSF-induced experimental samples". Data check (orientation.txt, log2 H/L): Stat5a pY694 positive in 12/12 mixtures (2.73 to 10), Stat3 pY705 positive in 12/12, Mapk3 pY205 positive in 12/12 (2.11 to 10), canonical G-CSF-induced sites; i.e. heavy = stimulated. Untreated per batch rule 4; sampling time not applicable for cells never stimulated.

claims.value: heavy: 1-2 within each (genotype, G-CSF, time); light: 1-4 within each (genotype, untreated, not applicable)
claims.evidence: Paper: each experiment "performed as two independent biological replicates" -> heavy Rep 1/2 from the .wiff Sample Name. Each mixture used its own light (unstimulated) culture (Suppl. Methods: 100 million cells per experiment, mixed 10 mg light + 10 mg heavy), so the four light cultures of a genotype share one factor-value group and get distinct numbers: 12.5 min Rep1->1, Rep2->2, 90 min Rep1->3, Rep2->4 (spec README.adoc:330, batch rule 3).

claims.value: wild-type G-CSFR (CSF3R) transduced / G-CSFR (CSF3R) T618I transduced / G-CSFR (CSF3R) Q741x truncation transduced
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol and paper: "a retroviral transduction approach was used with BaF3 cells to set-up an in vitro model system expressing WT, T618I, and Q741x G-CSFRs"; MSCV-IRES-GFP constructs, GFP-sorted. Custom characteristics column (spec Extending Templates), same wording as companion PXD009311.
Neupogen (human G-CSF, Amgen), 40 ng/mL; NCIT:C26078 "Granulocyte Colony-Stimulating Factor" (not obsolete).

PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; Cellosaurus OX NCBI_TaxID=10090; ProteinPilot UI_SPECIES Mus musculus.
Cellosaurus "Derived from site: In situ; Bone marrow; UBERON=UBERON_0002371".
Cellosaurus "Cell type: Pro-B cell; CL=CL_0000826". PRIDE cellTypes field lists "B cell" (submitter dropdown); the Cellosaurus term is more specific.
Cellosaurus caution: "Originally thought to originate from a BALB/c mouse but is in fact from a C3H mouse (PubMed=25277546)". Free-text column; validator ncbitaxon warning is expected.

Cultured Ba/F3 cell line.

Phospho-tyrosine peptide immunoaffinity purification on P-Tyr-1000 beads (Cell Signaling #8803); ProteinPilot special factor "Phos-Tyr affinity column". EFO:0010806 has no more specific child in OLS4.
Suppl. Methods: SILAC RPMI medium (Cambridge Isotope Laboratories #RPMI-500) without Lys/Arg, 5% dialyzed FBS; NCIT:C178973.

Every .wiff device record: "Component Name: Hybrid Quadrupole-TOF LC/MS/MS Mass Spectrometer, Component ID: TripleTOF 5600+, Manufacturer: AB Sciex Instruments" (serials BN20421209 for WT runs, BN23901410 for T618I/Q741x). Suppl. Methods and PRIDE protocol: TripleTOF 5600+. PRIDE instruments field MS:1000932 TripleTOF 5600 is the generic dropdown.
"one TOF-MS scan (0.25 s accumulation, 350 to 1600 m/z) following 20 information dependent acquisition (IDA) MS/MS scans on the most intense candidate ions".
TOF-MS scan "in a 350 to 1600 m/z window".
Product ion scans on the Q-TOF (TripleTOF 5600+), high sensitivity mode.
Collision-cell CID on a Sciex quadrupole-TOF; collision energy not stated, so comment[collision energy] is omitted.
TPCK-treated trypsin (Worthington), overnight; ProteinPilot UI_DIGESTION Trypsin in all 12 searches.
"reduced using DTT at a final concentration of 5 mM at 60 C for 20 min".
"alkylated using 10 mM iodoacetamide"; ProteinPilot UI_CYS_ALKYLATION Iodoacetamide.

claims.location: comment[modification parameters] (Carbamidomethyl C Fixed; Phospho S,T,Y Variable; Oxidation M; Deamidated N,Q)
claims.evidence: ProteinPilot Paragon is probabilistic, not fixed/variable. All 12 searches: UI_CYS_ALKYLATION Iodoacetamide, UI_SPECIAL_FACTOR "Phos-Tyr affinity column" (MOD_FEATURE_SET:43: Phospho(Ser,Thr) and Phospho on Tyr prob 0.49), UI_ID_FOCUS "Biological modifications", search effort Thorough. Fully decoded WT 12.5 min Rep 2 group, matches with confidence >= 0.95 (n=2876): C[CAM] 996, Y[Pho] 845, T[Pho] 26, M[Oxi] 123, N[Dea] 94, Q[Dea] 15 - the listed variable mods are the phosphorylation of the special factor plus the most frequent biological mods. Same convention as companion PXD009311.

All 12 searches: UI_SAMPLE_TYPE and UI_QUANT_TYPE "SILAC (Lys+8, Arg+10)"; Suppl. Methods search settings also "SILAC (Lys+8, Arg+10)"; PRIDE protocol heavy medium "C-13, N-15 Lysine and Arginine"; CIL catalogue numbers CNLM-539 / CNLM-291 are the CNLM (13C,15N) series. Decoded WT 12.5 min Rep 2: 2027 confident matches carry K[+08]/R[+10] vs 848 unlabelled K/R peptides. CONFLICT: Suppl. Methods reagent text says "13C6-Lysine and 13C6-Arginine" (= +6); the search settings, label masses observed and the CNLM catalogue numbers outweigh it. MT=Variable per batch rule 11.

claims.evidence: Batch rules 1 and 10; templates chosen: MS data, mouse cells (vertebrates), cell-line samples (cell-lines). No clinical/oncology template: engineered non-leukaemic cell line (rule 15).

limitations: Label-mass conflict: Supplementary Methods reagent paragraph says 13C6-Lys/13C6-Arg; ProteinPilot settings (all 12 searches), the Supplementary Methods search paragraph, the PRIDE protocol (C-13, N-15) and the observed K+8/R+10 matches say Lys8/Arg10. Annotated as Lys8/Arg10. The CIL catalogue pages could not be machine-read (JavaScript shell), so the catalogue identities rely on the CNLM (13C,15N) naming only.

Only one .group file (WT 12.5 min Rep 2) was decoded in full for modification counts and the tolerance preset; the other 11 were checked for identical UI settings (sample type, alkylation, digestion, special factor, instrument, species, effort, ID focus) only.

Independence of the light (unstimulated) culture in each mixture is inferred from per-experiment cell numbers (100 million cells, 10 mg light + 10 mg heavy mixed per experiment) and "two independent biological replicates"; not stated verbatim per mixture.

Correspondence of these 12 mixtures with the 12 mixtures of companion PXD009311 (pS/pT from the pY1000 flow-through per Sci Data) is stated at study level only; same source-name scheme used, replicate pairing across deposits not independently verified.
Not stated in the sources: species of the CSF3R cDNA, collision energy (rolling CE presumed, omitted), passage number, sex/age of the Ba/F3 donor mouse (Cellosaurus has none) -> not available.
No runs excluded: all 12 deposited .wiff runs are annotated. SearchEngineOutput.zip (12 .group) and QuantpYfiles.xlsx are search/quant outputs, not runs.
